summary: Milestone 2026.05.229 had no experiment commits within the timing window, making this the eighth consecutive empty-experiment milestone. Both RTX 3090 GPUs sat idle at 0% utilization with only 5 MB VRAM allocated each, consistent with a planning-only session. The pre-test cascade (duplicate module / ImportError) and the blocked_roadmap_missing recurrence remain the structural blockers preventing experiment activation.
bottlenecks_identified: blocked_roadmap_missing recurrence: eighth consecutive milestone where no research-roadmap-next.yaml was staged before archive, causing the conductor to skip experiment activation entirely.

Pre-test cascade unresolved: duplicate test_compositional_energy module / ImportError in test_dual_gpu.py continues to block the full test suite, which gates 11+ tasks that refuse to activate until the pre-test gate clears.
No compute-bound experiments ran, so GPU utilisation could not be evaluated; null gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks is correct by the GPU-IDLE INTERPRETATION RULE.
improvements_suggested: Pre-stage research-roadmap-next.yaml for .230 BEFORE archiving .229 — breaking the blocked_roadmap_missing cycle is the single highest-leverage action available.
Resolve pre-test ImportError in tests/python/test_dual_gpu.py and deduplicate test_compositional_energy module as a standalone fix task that runs ahead of all other .230 tasks.

Add a conductor guard that REFUSES to archive a milestone if research-roadmap-next.yaml for the next milestone does not already exist, turning the absent-roadmap failure mode into an explicit hard block with a clear error message.
Consider marking exp2338 (Semantic Energy Hallucination Detector, committed outside the timing window) as a .229 carry-in so the next retro captures it accurately in experiments_completed.

Both GPUs remain consistently idle across eight milestones; DualGPURunner is appropriate only once 2+ models run in parallel, but the immediate priority is unblocking any experiment activation at all.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Pre-stage research-roadmap-next.yaml for milestone 2026.05.230 immediately, before any other work, to break the eight-milestone blocked_roadmap_missing streak.

Fix the pre-test suite (test_dual_gpu.py ImportError + duplicate test_compositional_energy module) as the very first task in .230 activation, clearing the gate that blocks 11 of 14 queued experiment tasks.

Add a conductor-level pre-archive guard that requires research-roadmap-next.yaml to exist before the archive step succeeds, making future blocked_roadmap_missing structurally impossible without explicit operator override.
meta_reflection: Eight consecutive empty-experiment milestones reveal a systemic process gap: the roadmap hand-off between archive and activation is fragile and has no mechanical safety net. The pre-test cascade and the absent-roadmap problem are co-blockers — fixing either one alone is insufficient because a passing test suite still needs a roadmap to activate, and a staged roadmap still cannot run if the pre-test gate fails. Both must be resolved together at the start of .230 before any research experiments are proposed.
